vs_A1u.note: baseline arm (the comparison reference of the adoption gate)

gate.K1: after-tax $100k K - A1u >= 0.0 pp in all three windows
gate.K2: clean bootstrap (seed 20261011, block 20, $100k) K - A1u median >= 0.0 pp and share > 0 >= 50% (B1-recent and B2-flat)
gate.K3: pre-tax main-window max DD, K <= A1u + 1.0 pp (base and calibrated, m = 2)
gate.K4: 21 January rolling starts: K - A1u >= 0 in >= 60%
gate.S1: pre-tax main-window CAGR, K >= C0 + -0.1 pp (base and calibrated)
gate.S2: pre-tax main-window max DD, K <= C0 + 1.0 pp (base and calibrated)
gate.adopt: K iff K1 and K2 and K3 and K4 and S1 and S2 and S3; else A1u alone

gates.reason: K passes K1-K4 and S1-S3 (H2 adds to the band)

params.composition: K = A1u + H2. On a pending discretionary downward resize the H2 December window is tested FIRST: if the fill session is one of the last DEC_TAIL December sessions and 0 < target < held weight, the resize is postponed; otherwise A1u's gain-scaled band decides. Exits to zero and up-resizes always fill. A suppressed or postponed resize is never re-tried: the target is re-evaluated at every close.

params.instrument: synthetic QLD* daily-reset 2x on QQQ total return, expense 0.95%/yr, financing DTB3 + {base 0.0, calibrated 0.75%/yr}
params.reason: K passes K1-K4 and S1-S3 (H2 adds to the band)
params.signals: production R2 (equity_leveraged_trend_v1 1.2.0): E2 2-of-3 on price closes (SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint) + early re-entry at 0.5 x vt while E2 off and close > SMA50, vol20 < its 252-session median and close > close 20 sessions ago; exit early below SMA50
params.sizing: vt = min(1, 0.35/vol20) on synthetic QLD*, cap 0.98
